Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

sdmApp 0.0.3

Breaking and infrastructure changes

  • Dropped the archived rgdal and rgeos dependencies. sdmApp now relies on raster (>= 3.6.3), which reaches GDAL, GEOS and PROJ through terra, so the package installs again on current R.
  • Reworked DESCRIPTION: packages actually used by the exported functions moved to Imports; the modelling engines used only inside the shiny interface stay in Suggests and are checked at launch.
  • NAMESPACE is now generated by roxygen2 from targeted @importFrom tags instead of a blanket exportPattern() and long @import lists.

blockCV 3.0+ support

  • sdmApp_fold_Explorer() now accepts the objects returned by blockCV::cv_spatial() and the other cv_*() functions of blockCV 3.0 and later, while still accepting legacy SpatialBlock objects.
  • The shiny interface’s “Spatial autocorrelation” and “Spatial blocking” tabs now call cv_spatial_autocor(), cv_spatial() and cv_plot() instead of spatialAutoRange(), spatialBlock() and summarise_fold(), which no longer exist in blockCV. blockCV (>= 3.0.0) is now required.

New features

  • sdmApp_PA(), sdmApp_RasterPlot(), sdmApp_TimesRasters() and sdmApp_fold_Explorer() accept terra::SpatRaster objects as well as raster objects.

Fixes

  • The theme argument of sdmApp() is honoured again. global.R checked for a shiny option (sdmAppInvoked) that sdmApp() never set, so the deployment defaults always overwrote the chosen theme and referenced a non-existent JavaScript file.

  • sdmApp() restores the global options() it changes once the app stops, rejects non-positive or vector maxRequestSize values instead of silently replacing them, validates debug, and lets ... override launch.browser.

  • sdmApp_PA() labels presence and absence by value rather than by position, so a raster holding only presences is no longer shown as “Absence”; non-binary rasters are rejected.

  • sdmApp_TimesRasters() checks that both rasters share extent, resolution and CRS.

  • sdmApp_fold_Explorer() rejects fold index 0 and non-integer indices, colours points by the column the folds were built on (instead of the first column), and uses linewidth for block outlines.

  • stringr and sp, used by the shiny interface, are declared in Suggests and checked at launch; unused graphics import removed; invalid placeholder ORCID removed from DESCRIPTION.

  • sdmApp() no longer calls itself recursively and builds the shiny app only once. It validates theme and maxRequestSize up front and stops with an informative message listing any missing suggested packages.

  • Replaced the deprecated ggplot2::aes_string() with aes() and .data[[ ]] across the mapping helpers.

  • Replaced guides(fill = FALSE) with guides(fill = "none").

  • Replaced fragile class(x) == "SpatialBlock" comparisons with inherits().

  • Added input validation to sdmApp_PA(), sdmApp_RasterPlot(), sdmApp_TimesRasters() and sdmApp_fold_Explorer().

Testing and CI

  • Replaced the placeholder unit tests with real tests that exercise the exported functions against the bundled example data.
  • Rebuilt the GitHub Actions workflows (R-CMD-check, pkgdown, test-coverage, lint) on r-lib/actions v2 and current runners. The lint workflow now lives in .github/workflows/ (it previously sat at the repository root and never ran) and is configured by .lintr.
